nonFiniteAudit.differentialResult: All non-finite categories are structurally identical in the earlier local bundle: 1 particle Infinity, 6 AnimatorController NaN/Infinity values, and 23,652 Mesh AABB sentinel floats. They are therefore not credible differential causes for this rejection.
nonFiniteAudit.startLifetimeConclusion: Unity 2022.3 explicitly documents float.PositiveInfinity as valid for infinite particle lifetime. It is not malformed Unity data. It can only remain an undocumented VRChat compatibility variable, but the accepted predecessor used the same value.

Both are EditorOnly scene objects outside the avatar and absent from the final MonoScript list

Performance ranking does not impose a public hard cap beyond Very Poor; official documentation separately warns extremely unoptimized avatars may be prevented

why: Store maxParticles changed 64 -> 16,384 (256x) in the rejected revision
It is the largest user-visible behavior change and directly affects allocated particle capacity
Final Total Particles Active is 16,385 by VRChat performance-stat definition; this is far beyond the public Poor threshold of 2,500 and has no public upper threshold
A 64-capacity Store with the same +Infinity lifetime previously loaded
riskRanking.doNotClaim: Do not treat the old 50,000 limiter as the server threshold or claim 16,384 is the confirmed cause.

riskRanking.risk: New catalog renderer/shader/material asset is rejected by an undocumented validator
why: The rejected build adds MorphForge/ParticleBoxCatalog, ParticleBoxCatalog.mat, CatalogAtlas.png and CatalogMetadata
CatalogMetadata is a 16,384 x 1 RGBAFloat Texture2D; CatalogAtlas is 384 x 96 RGBA32
A custom MorphForge shader existed before and was accepted, so this is a differential compatibility candidate rather than a general ban on custom shaders
riskRanking.doNotClaim: Do not claim VRChat blocks custom shaders or RGBAFloat textures based on available evidence.

riskRanking.risk: Server false positive or transient analysis state
why: Official VRChat documentation acknowledges server-side security checks and removal of false positives
Three repeated client requests within 12 seconds all returned the same 403 verdict
riskRanking.confidence: low-medium; deterministic within this upload, but cannot exclude a mistakenly classified bundle

riskRanking.risk: Undisclosed asset-level incompatibility from newly added placement animator clips

Overall animation channels are unchanged and total controller work decreased
No malformed animation curve values are unique to this revision

Keep Store.maxParticles=16384 but restore the old MorphForge/ParticleBoxLocalUV material/shader and exclude CatalogAtlas/CatalogMetadata.
